facts: The 21.24-metre seven-story Phước Duyên Tower was built between 1844 and 1846 for King Thiệu Trị.

record: UNESCO Complex of Hué Monuments listing
facts: Thiên Mụ is part of the designated Nguyen-era ritual landscape of Huế.
The temple group includes a great bell, ceremonial stele, the main worship hall and smaller buildings along the main axis.
The temple stands beside the Perfume River. The central tower and neighboring structures make up the first entrance court.
